full_prompt_en: A square hand-drawn cartoon illustration shows a wide-eyed boy seated on a faded green sofa inside a cluttered room. He has sharply spiked dark brown hair, large round white eyes with tiny pupils, a long rounded nose, and an uncertain expression. A loose muted red T-shirt hangs over his narrow torso, and blue trousers bend at the knees. Both hands grip a small gray game controller in his lap, while his gaze points toward something beyond the right side of the frame. At the left end of the sofa, a small blue-gray dog with a bright yellow eye looks in the same general direction. Behind the boy, the wall is dark turquoise, cracked and scuffed, with framed sketches hung at different heights. A small table or shelf carries a lamp and miniature objects, while open shelves to the right hold bottles, cups, and other household clutter. A warm orange glow rises from a recess at the far right, contrasting with the cool green room. The sofa is upholstered with worn, sagging cushions, and the dog and boy both sit low within its bulky arms. Black ink outlines are slightly uneven and expressive, while translucent washes and rough hatching give texture to skin, fabric, plaster, and furniture. Light comes from the orange right side and a softer ambient source, producing gentle warm-cool contrast without realistic hard shadows. The composition is cropped closely around the seated figures, but background props establish a lived-in environment. The scene balances exaggerated facial comedy with finely observed wear, making the still gaming moment feel both funny and oddly subdued.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘卡通插画描绘一名大眼男孩坐在杂乱房间的褪色绿沙发上。他有尖翘的深棕乱发、巨大白眼与小瞳孔、圆长鼻子和不确定的表情。松松的暗红T恤罩着细瘦躯干，蓝裤在膝处弯折。双手握着腿上的小灰色游戏手柄，视线望向画面右侧之外。沙发左端，一只蓝灰色小狗露出明亮黄眼，也大致朝相同方向看。男孩身后是暗青绿色墙，带裂纹和磨损，不同高度挂着框好的草图。一张小桌或架子放着灯和微型物件，右侧开放搁板摆着瓶子、杯子和其他日常杂物。最右侧凹处升起暖橙光，与冷绿房间形成对照。沙发软包磨旧、靠垫下陷，狗与男孩都低低坐在厚实扶手之间。黑色墨线轮廓略不均匀且富于表情，透明色洗和粗糙排线为肌肤、布料、灰泥与家具添质地。光来自橙色右侧和较柔的环境光，形成温和冷暖对照，而非真实的硬阴影。构图紧贴坐着的角色裁切，但背景道具建立有人生活过的环境。场景平衡夸张面部喜感和对磨损的细致观察，使静止的游戏时刻既好笑又有点低落。
style_prompt_en: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration combines elastic facial proportions and expressive uneven ink contours with a textured, lived-in environment. Muted teal, olive, dusty red, denim blue, and warm orange are applied in layered translucent washes, leaving rough hatching and scuffs visible. Exaggerated eyes and noses supply immediate character, while furniture and small props receive quiet observational detail. Soft mixed illumination creates a warm-cool edge without hard photoreal shadow. A close crop and slightly sagging shapes keep the mood intimate, comic, and gently worn.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘卡通插画把有弹性的面部比例、富于表情且不均匀的墨线轮廓，与有生活痕迹的纹理环境结合。低饱和青绿、橄榄、蒙尘红、牛仔蓝和暖橙以层叠透明色洗施加，留下粗排线和擦痕。夸张眼睛与鼻子立即建立性格，家具和小道具则获得安静的观察细节。柔和混合照明造出冷暖边缘，没有照片般硬阴影。近景裁切与略塌的形状让情绪亲密、喜剧化且温和磨旧。
theme_en: A wide-eyed cartoon boy holding a game controller on a sofa
theme_zh: 一名大眼卡通男孩坐在沙发上握着游戏手柄
name: Stephan Pastis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
